Founder & Lead Faculty

Meet Sanjay Saraf Sir

Sanjay Saraf Sir is the founder and driving force behind SSEI. He began teaching at 16, charging ₹75 a month and turned that passion into one of India’s most trusted finance prep institutes. A CFA and FRM charterholder with an MS in Finance from ICFAI Hyderabad and over 30 years of teaching, he is both an academician and a practitioner.

A Gold Medalist honoured by the late Dr. Manmohan Singh, he brings academic rigour and real-world expertise together to produce exam toppers and industry-ready professionals.
